rules.title: How to play
rules.intro: A game for two on a hexagonal board of 61 spaces. You each have 14 marbles.

goal.title: The goal
goal.body: Push six of your opponent's marbles off the board.

directions.title: Six directions
directions.body: A marble moves one space in any of six directions. There are no diagonals and no jumps.
directions.caption: The six directions.

move.title: Moving marbles
move.body: Move one, two or three of your own marbles. Two or three must sit in a straight line and move together.
move.inline_caption: In line: the row advances the way it points.
move.broadside_caption: Broadside: the row steps sideways onto empty spaces.

push.title: Pushing
push.body: Only a move in line can push, and you need more marbles than your opponent: two against one, or three against one or two. The space behind theirs must be empty.
push.ok_caption: Three against two: the line shifts one space.
push.blocked_caption: Equal numbers never move, and you never push your own.

capture.title: Pushing marbles off
capture.body: A marble pushed past the edge is out for good. Six of them wins the game.
capture.caption: Two against one at the edge: black is out.

local.title: Two players, one device
local.description: Black moves first, then you take turns.
